kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتضامن (form VI)
# نَتَضَامَنُ (nataḍāmanu) /na.ta.dˤaː.ma.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَضَامَنَ (taḍāmana)
# نَتَضَامَنَ (nataḍāmana) /na.ta.dˤaː.ma.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَضَامَنَ (taḍāmana)
# نَتَضَامَنْ (nataḍāman) /na.ta.dˤaː.man/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَضَامَنَ (taḍāmana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
